summary: Chef Story is a cute and cozy cooking game, Build & Design your own restaurant
description:
Hi Chef, let’s build the most amazing Food Park! 
The Park is waiting to be filled with food trucks and stalls from around the world to cook and serve various delicious foods and desserts! 
Starting with Indonesia’s sweet, rich, and fluffy Martabak. Crispy and sweet golden banana fritters... and many more!

Help the shop cook and serve visiting customers, take their orders, keep your eye on the time, tap the correct ingredients, and quickly serve your waiting customers. 
Let’s make the food park an unforgettable experience for all your customers!

Cooking Chef Story is a cute and cozy cooking game you'll get hooked on! 
Easy to learn game with simple touch controls! 
Serve up all kinds of dishes to your customers and create an amazing food park!

Cooking Chef Story Features

Build, create and decorate your own unique food park! 
A variety of famous and exotic dishes and recipes! 
Start with Indonesian food and then the world! 
Upgrade all of your kitchenware and ingredients! 
Use many kinds of boosts and power-ups to improve your abilities! 
Hundreds of levels for you to unlock and play! 
Compete with your friends to be the best food park owner!
Serve all kinds of cute and wacky customers!
Get amazing combos and earn big tips! 
Unique idle game sim system! 
Relaxing, soothing and cozy game enjoyable for people of all ages!

Build your food park to be the best in the world! Or just enjoy the relaxing and cozy atmosphere and watch cute customers visiting your parks.
